id.description: Unique identification of the payment order.

approvalId.description: The id of the approval request that is or was used to get this item approved.

status.description: The internal DBS status of the payment order..

bankStatus.description: Internal status of the payment or batch order in the core banking system.

reasonCode.description: Reason code the core banking system accepted/rejected the payment or batch.

reasonText.description: Human readable reason the core banking system accepted/rejected the payment or batch.

errorDescription.description: Additional information from the core banking system on why the payment was refused.

createdAt.description: Date and time indicating when the payment was created

updatedAt.description: Date and time indicating when the payment was updated

version.description: Indication of what version the payment order currently has

intraLegalEntity.description: Indication if this payment was an intra-company payment.

originatorAccountCurrency.description: Currency code of the payment order originating account

confirmationId.description: The confirmation id for transaction signing.

paymentSetupId.description: Generated when the PISP sets up the payments before the Backbase authorization flow.

paymentSubmissionId.description: Generated when the PISP submits the payment which is after the Backbase authorization flow.

batchBooking.description: Indicate whenever there should be only one debit posting for the whole set of instructions

instructionPriority.description: Specify the priority of execution of the payment order.

requestedExecutionDate.description: The preferred date for the payment order to be executed.

paymentMode.description: Denotes whether payment will be single or will be recurring

entryClass.description: Used for ACH Standard Entry Class (SEC) Code to designate how the transaction was authorized by the originator.

Actions.description: An array of actions that could be performed on a payment order. Actions that can be done are dependant on the payment itself.

items.description: The actions that can be performed by the user (with the current context). This field is not evaluated when payment is requested by support employee on behalf of another user.

description.description: This gives a more in detailed description of the item and its purpose.

rank.description: The rank determines which item takes precedence over another. 1 means highest precedence and 100 takes lower precedence than 10. Must be unique!

ApprovalTypeDto.description: An approval type, also known as approval level, is used to allow a hierarchy of approvals to grant to various users or groups to allow complex policies to be defined.

bankBranchCode.description: Some code to identify a bank office, p.e. ABA routing transit number (9) or Swift BIC code (11)

bic.description: Business identifier code as specified by ISO 9362:2014

Bank.description: This object is used to identify the counterparty or correspondent bank.

externalUserId.description: The (unique and human readable) external user id of the user.

internalUserId.description: General purpose identifier. Can be UUID but does not have to.

serviceAgreementId.description: General purpose identifier. Can be UUID but does not have to.

legalEntityId.description: General purpose identifier. Can be UUID but does not have to.

origin.description: Name the system where endpoint is calling from

accountType.description: The type of the account, e.g. for ACH we have CHECKING/SAVINGS

name.description: Default name field used in DBS

CounterpartyAccount.description: The counterparty Account is the original account identification plus the arrangement if applicable.

currencyCode.description: Currency in which the rate of exchange is expressed in a currency exchange.

rate.description: The factor used for conversion of an amount from one currency to another.

rateType.description: Specifies the type used to complete the currency exchange.

contractIdentification.description: Unique and unambiguous reference to the foreign exchange contract agreed between the initiating party/creditor and the debtor agent.

ExchangeRateInformation.description: The detailed information on the exchange rate that has been used in the payment transaction.

identification.description: The identifier of the account. Can be a regular account number, or an ID.

schemeName.description: This describes the type of the account identifier. ID will mean it refers to an account known within DBS.

messageToBank.description: The message to the bank used for US domestic wire payments

targetCurrency.description: The alpha-3 code (complying with ISO 4217) of the currency

mandateIdentifier.description: The mandate identifier, of the counter party, giving permission for the debit order.

chargeBearer.description: Indicated who pays the fees for an international transfer. Possible values: OUR(originator), BEN(beneficiary or SHA(shared).

IdentifiedTransaction.description: The object defining the identified transaction, which means the counterparty will have a arrangementId where applicable.

role.description: These are the possible values the role of an involved party can  have.

recipientId.description: Used for ACH Credit to indicate the id of the recipient

InvolvedParty.description: This object is a common denominator for the debtor or creditor party.

rank.description: Rank of this logical operation with 1 as the highest precedence. The rank is unique inside the details list.

operator.description: Type of logical operation, please see Community for each operation implementation

items.description: List of policy items inside this logical operation.

LogicalPolicyDetailsDto.description: A policy declaration that allows you to add logical operators to the contained policy items.

name.description: This is the name of the account, and not the name of the account holder.

OriginatorAccount.description: The product identification of the originator

numberOfApprovals.description: The number of a certain type of approval that is required.

PolicyItemDetailsDto.description: A detailed policy item with the full approval type.

userId.description: General purpose identifier. Can be UUID but does not have to.

externalUserId.description: The (unique and human readable) external user id of the user.

userFullName.description: The full name of a user.

serviceAgreementId.description: General purpose identifier. Can be UUID but does not have to.

itemId.description: General purpose identifier. Can be UUID but does not have to.

dataAccessItemId.description: General purpose identifier. Can be UUID but does not have to.

resource.description: This is the name of the resource.

function.description: This is the name of the business function.

records.description: A list of records of all the approve and reject actions on the approval.

canApprove.description: This flag indicates if the user (with the current context) that is requesting the approval can approve it, depending on the policy that applies. In case a support employee requests the payment on behalf of another user, this flag is indicating whether the target user can approve the item and not the support employee himself.

canReject.description: This flag indicates if the user (with the current context) that is requesting the approval can reject it, depending on the policy that applies. In case a support employee requests the payment on behalf of another user, this flag is indicating whether the target user can reject the item and not the support employee himself.

finalApprover.description: This flag indicates if the user (with the current context) is the final approver that is needed. In case a support employee requests the payment on behalf of another user, this flag is indicating whether the target user is a final approver and not the support employee himself.

action.description: The action of the approval request

createdAt.description: The timestamp indicates when the object was created.

PresentationApprovalDetailDto.description: A detailed approval object that holds extended details of a single item to be approved.

description.description: This gives a more in detailed description of the item and its purpose.

rank.description: The rank determines which item takes precedence over another. 1 means highest precedence and 100 takes lower precedence than 10. Must be unique!

PresentationApprovalTypeDto.description: A simple object that represents a type of approval that can be placed on an approval.

name.description: Default name field used in DBS

description.description: This gives a more in detailed description of the item and its purpose.

items.description: A list of approval types and the number of each approval type is required. If there are 0 items a zero-approval-policy applies.

logicalItems.description: Contains a list of logical approval policy items. These items have been used in the calculation of this approval state.

PresentationPolicyDto.description: This object describes how a policy is built up. It tells you what policies apply (#policyItems) or if you can self-approve.

numberOfApprovals.description: The number of a certain type of approval that is required.

userId.description: General purpose identifier. Can be UUID but does not have to.

externalUserId.description: The (unique and human readable) external user id of the user.

userFullName.description: The full name of a user.

status.description: The list of accepted statuses that a user can request to update an approval to.

createdAt.description: The timestamp indicates when the object was created.

comment.description: When approving or rejecting, the user can add comments which would explain the reason for the action.

PresentationRecordDto.description: A single record of either an approval or rejection by a user on an approval request.

type.description: When type is structured it consists of some XML tags used when the transaction was uploaded.

content.description: The content of the remittance information.

RemittanceInformation.description: This is the object representation of the remittance info and can contain different types of remittance info. It is only used in responses, not for input requests!

nonWorkingDayExecutionStrategy.description: Strategy for executing payments on non-working days

transferFrequency.description: Denotes how frequently the transfer should be made

on.description: Denotes day on which transfer should be executed. For WEEKLY transferFrequency it will be 1..7 indicating weekday. For BIWEEKLY it will be 1..14 indicating the day of the two week period. For MONTHLY it will be 1..31 indicating day of month. For YEARLY it will be 1..12 indicating month of the year.

startDate.description: When to start executing the schedule. First transfer will be executed on first calculated date by schedule after this date.

endDate.description: When to stop transfers. Transfers will not be executed after this date. Only one of endDate and repeat is possible. If neither repeat nor endDate is provided transfer will be executed until canceled

repeat.description: Number of transfer to be executed. Only one of endDate and repeat is possible. If neither repeat nor endDate is provided transfer will be executed until canceled

every.description: Indicates skip interval of transfer. 1 would mean execute every time, 2 - every other time

nextExecutionDate.description: Date when the next payment will be executed, taking in consideration bank holidays and cut-off times. It will be only retrieved when getting payments, it will be dismissed when creating or updating.

Schedule.description: Schedule for recurring transfer. Mandatory if paymentMode is RECURRING

amount.description: The amount in the specified currency

currencyCode.description: The alpha-3 code (complying with ISO 4217) of the currency that qualifies the amount
